description: 医療機関一覧 [hospitals and health facilities] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 新上五島町. 新上五島町の医療機関一覧です。. Coverage: 新上五島町. The portal files it under the publisher 新上五島町. Its tags are 健康, 医療機関, 救急医療. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2019-10-01 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution 2.1 JP. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
